title: Harden T-11's consumer tests: prove prepare rebuilds dist, and make alternateCss fail loudly under a bad asset root
spec:
Two advisory findings from T-11's review (.autodev/reviews/T-11.md), waived there and filed here so they are not lost.

ACs:
1. test/consumer.test.ts AC3 block removes dist/ before npm pack, so the test can tell 'prepare rebuilt dist' from 'a stale dist already sat on disk'. Check: remove scripts.prepare temporarily → the test goes red.
2. alternateCss() under a REPO_TOUR_ASSETS override that points at a directory with no skins/ throws or warns the same way baseCss() does, instead of returning an empty string. Check: a unit test with a garbage override.
3. The explicit-config-beats-env precedence is tested for grammarsDir as it is for assetsDir. Check: the test.

Out of scope
- Any behaviour change to skins or extract beyond the failure mode — deferred: who=agent:pm why=T-11 shipped the contract; this only hardens its tests and one silent failure
